# reels-wiki

> Local-first Python pipeline that converts saved Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok videos into deduplicated atomic Markdown notes inside a 3-layer Obsidian LLM Wiki vault.

## Key Capabilities

- **Multi-Platform URL Normalization & Deduplication**: Maps Instagram `/reel/`, `/reels/`, `/p/`, `/tv/`, and `/share/...` redirects to 11-character shortcodes, YouTube Shorts (`yt_<id>`), and TikTok videos (`tt_<id>`), tracking state in `sources/.reels_index.json` + append-only `inbox/reels-queue.jsonl`.
- **3-Stage Cost-Aware Extraction**:
  1. `yt-dlp` metadata and captions (`min_caption_chars: 150`).
  2. Audio transcription via Groq `whisper-large-v3-turbo` or offline `faster-whisper`.
  3. Frame OCR via `ffmpeg` + Gemini Vision (`gemini-2.5-flash`), including image-only `/p/` carousel fallback.
- **Multi-Provider Synthesis & Weekly Digests**: Supports Groq (`openai/gpt-oss-120b`), Google Gemini (`gemini-2.5-flash`), and offline OpenAI-compatible local models (`ollama`), with automatic JSON repair, content-hash skip on reprocess, sandboxed custom `template_path`, token/retry observability, and `reels-sync digest --days 7` weekly summary generation in `digests/<YYYY-MM-DD>-digest.md`.
- **Browser Extension & Offline Auto-Sync**: Chrome/Firefox MV3 extension (`extension/`) captures Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok URLs from the popup or right-click context menu via `reels-sync serve`, stores unreachable URLs in `pendingQueue`, and flushes automatically every 5 minutes using `chrome.alarms`.
- **Unattended Deployment**: Ships `Dockerfile` (`python:3.12-slim` + `ffmpeg`, non-root), `docker-compose.yml`, macOS `launchd`, and Linux `systemd` user timer examples.
- **6 Interfaces**: CLI (`reels-sync` with `init`, `doctor`, `digest`), Python SDK (`reels_wiki`), MCP Server (`reels-wiki-mcp` exposing `enqueue_reel`, `import_ig_export`, `process_reels_queue`, `get_queue_stats`, `reprocess_reel`, `search_vault_notes`), Telegram Capture Bot (`reels-wiki-telegram`), Local HTTP Ingest (`reels-sync serve` for Apple Shortcuts & browser extensions), and Agent Skill (`SKILL.md`).

## Quick Start

```bash
pip install reels-wiki
reels-sync init
reels-sync doctor
reels-sync ingest "https://www.instagram.com/reel/DAbCdEfGhIj/"
reels-sync process --limit 10
reels-sync digest --days 7
```
